title: Seventy years of RNA biology
subtitle: Selected milestones by theme. Hover or tap a marker for details.

events.label: mRNA
events.detail: Brenner, Jacob & Meselson and Gros et al. show an unstable RNA carries genetic information from genes to ribosomes. Jacob & Monod name it messenger RNA.

events.label: Genetic code solved
events.detail: Begun with Nirenberg & Matthaei's poly(U) experiment in 1961; Holley sequenced the first tRNA in 1965. Nobel 1968 to Holley, Khorana & Nirenberg.

events.label: Reverse transcriptase
events.detail: Temin & Mizutani and Baltimore show RNA can be copied back into DNA. Nobel 1975.

events.label: 5′ cap
events.detail: The m7G cap on eukaryotic mRNA is identified by several groups (Shatkin, Furuichi, Miura and colleagues).

events.label: Splicing
events.detail: Berget, Moore & Sharp and Chow, Gelinas, Broker & Roberts discover split genes in adenovirus. Nobel 1993 to Roberts & Sharp.

events.label: Self-splicing intron
events.detail: Cech's lab shows a Tetrahymena intron splices itself out with no protein. Nobel (Chemistry) 1989 to Cech & Altman.

events.label: RNase P
events.detail: Altman's lab shows the RNA subunit of RNase P is the catalyst. Nobel (Chemistry) 1989.

events.label: “The RNA world”
events.detail: Walter Gilbert names the hypothesis that early life ran on RNA alone.

events.label: Ribosome is a ribozyme
events.detail: Atomic structures (Ban, Nissen et al.) show the peptidyl transferase center is made of RNA. Nobel (Chemistry) 2009 to Ramakrishnan, Steitz & Yonath.

events.label: XIST
events.detail: A long noncoding RNA that silences one X chromosome in female cells.

events.label: lin-4 microRNA
events.detail: Lee, Feinbaum & Ambros and Wightman, Ha & Ruvkun discover the first microRNA in C. elegans. Nobel 2024 to Ambros & Ruvkun.

events.label: RNAi
events.detail: Fire, Mello and colleagues show double-stranded RNA silences matching genes. Nobel 2006.

events.label: let-7
events.detail: A second microRNA, conserved from worms to humans, shows miRNAs are a general mechanism.

events.label: siRNA in mammals
events.detail: Elbashir, Tuschl and colleagues silence mammalian genes with 21-nucleotide duplexes.

events.label: CRISPR guide RNA
events.detail: Jinek et al. reprogram Cas9 with a dual-RNA guide. Nobel (Chemistry) 2020 to Charpentier & Doudna.

events.label: m6A in mRNA
events.detail: Desrosiers, Friderici & Rottman (and Perry & Kelley) find N6-methyladenosine inside messenger RNA.

events.label: METTL3 cloned
events.detail: Bokar et al. identify MT-A70, the methyltransferase subunit later named METTL3.

events.label: FTO erases m6A
events.detail: Jia et al. show the obesity-associated protein FTO demethylates m6A, implying the mark is reversible.

events.label: m6A maps
events.detail: MeRIP-seq (Meyer et al.) and m6A-seq (Dominissini et al.) map m6A across the transcriptome: thousands of genes, enriched near stop codons.

events.label: Writers & readers
events.detail: The METTL3–METTL14 writer complex is defined, and YTHDF2 is shown to route methylated mRNA to decay.

events.label: Direct RNA nanopore
events.detail: Garalde et al. sequence native RNA molecules, carrying their modifications, through a nanopore.

events.label: NASEM report
events.detail: The National Academies call for a coordinated effort to sequence RNA and its modifications.

events.label: First antisense drug
events.detail: Fomivirsen is approved for CMV retinitis.

events.label: Modified nucleosides
events.detail: Karikó, Weissman and colleagues show modified nucleosides let mRNA evade innate immune sensors. Nobel 2023.

events.label: Nusinersen
events.detail: A splice-switching antisense drug for spinal muscular atrophy.

events.label: First siRNA drug
events.detail: Patisiran is approved for hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis.

events.label: mRNA vaccines
events.detail: Modified-nucleoside mRNA vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 are authorized in December 2020.

events.label: Bespoke base editing
events.detail: An infant with CPS1 deficiency receives a personalized, mRNA-encoded base editor delivered by lipid nanoparticles.

events.label: SpliceAI
events.detail: A deep network predicts splicing from raw sequence and flags cryptic splice variants.

events.label: m6Anet
events.detail: Multiple-instance learning detects m6A from nanopore current signal.

events.label: AlphaFold 3
events.detail: Structure prediction extends to complexes containing RNA and DNA. (The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognized AlphaFold's earlier protein-structure work.)
